title: Implementation Operations Manager
job_description:
Implementation Operations Manager

Join the customer operations group to make enterprise deployments predictable and scalable. You will coordinate implementation readiness, partner with vendors and customers, and improve the operating rhythm behind each launch.

Basic Qualifications
- 3+ years coordinating customer implementations, onboarding, or deployment operations.
- Experience managing implementation plans, customer stakeholders, and issue escalation.
- Experience coordinating vendors and tracking launch readiness.
- Experience preparing operational reporting for leadership.
- Experience with Workday implementation projects.

Preferred Qualifications
- Experience tracking project budgets or purchase orders.
- Formal change-management certification.
- Experience with Salesforce reporting.
